Section 16. Input tax credit
(1) Every registered person shall be entitled to take credit of input tax.
(a) The input tax credit shall include tax charged on inward supplies.
(i) This clause applies where the registered person is eligible to claim the credit.
Provided that this credit shall not be available for certain blocked supplies.
Explanation. For the purposes of this section, blocked supply means a supply ineligible for credit.

Section 17. Blocked credits and restricted credit
(1) The amount of credit available to a person shall be calculated under this section.
(2) The credit shall not be available for personal consumption or exempt supplies.
(a) For the avoidance of doubt, the quantity of blocked credit shall be separately identified.
Provided that where a supplier is not registered, the claim may be restricted.
